name: Luo Xuan Qi Zheng
source: High school senior Lu Zhiyao wakes up to April 11 again and again— but only his closest friend, Jiang Wanli, chooses to believe him. Their search for a way out draws them closer— until Lu finally discovers that he is part of the mystery he is trying to solve. The answer can only be written tomorrow.
translation: 高三学生路知遥一次又一次在4月11日醒来——唯有他最亲密的好友江万里选择相信他。寻找脱困之法的过程让两人的心越走越近——直到路知遥终于发现，他自己正是这场待解谜团的一部分。而答案，唯有在明天方能写就。
